educationalNote: Investigative / educational mapping of public historical cases only. Not a live crime feed. Coordinates are taken from court opinions and reputable public reporting; uncertain street addresses are omitted or marked approximate.

cases.name: Anthony Sowell
cases.summary: Eleven women were murdered and their remains concealed at Sowell’s home at 12205 Imperial Avenue. Ohio Supreme Court opinions identify that address as the kill and body-recovery site; individual street-level last-seen points are mostly unpublished, so v1 maps the court-confirmed residence locus and a chronological victim list rather than inventing neighborhood pins.
cases.attribution: Ohio Supreme Court, State v. Sowell, 2016-Ohio-8025 (public court opinion); contemporaneous Cleveland Plain Dealer / cleveland.com identification reporting for disappearance chronology.

sites.title: #1–11 · Imperial Avenue residence
sites.summary: Court-documented kill and body-recovery site for all eleven aggravated-murder victims. Remains were found inside the house and buried in the yard after search warrants beginning 29 Oct 2009.

cases.name: Alton Coleman
cases.summary: Multi-state 1984 spree with court-documented Ohio murders (Toledo, Cincinnati, Norwood) plus earlier Wisconsin/Illinois/Indiana/Michigan crimes. City-level pins are used when opinions name a city but not a street; May & Morgan (Cincinnati) is intersection-level approximate from Ohio Supreme Court findings.
cases.attribution: Ohio Supreme Court, State v. Coleman, 37 Ohio St.3d 286 (1988) and 45 Ohio St.3d 298 (1989); public encyclopedic summaries of the 1984 spree for out-of-Ohio localities corroborated by contemporaneous news archives.

sites.title: #1 kill / body · Vernita Wheat
